Wine debug d3d + normal log

Clip Studio Paint on Wine (version X.Y) exhibits a rendering issue where certain UI components — specifically the Settings window and the Login window — appear completely black when opened. Despite the lack of visible content, the menus remain clickable and functional if the user knows where to click. This behavior makes it extremely difficult to use those parts of the application effectively.
